subject: Customer erasure request — prompts/outputs/logs finalization and confirmation templates
messages:
From: Emma Bradshaw <emma.bradshaw@luminapay.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs for LuminaPay EU tenant

Hi Vivek,

We need to initiate a scoped purge for the LuminaPay EU tenant. Scope: all prompt inputs, generated outputs, and request logs tied to the SID tenancy for dates between 2026-01-01 and 2028-05-01. This is driven by an internal compliance clean-up and a customer data retention policy update.

Can you confirm the end-to-end workflow we should expect (ops run, evidence, timelines) and provide the standard confirmation email you send back to the customer once deletion is complete? LuminaPay legal may need the certificate for their records.

Thanks,
Emma Bradshaw
Head of Platform Compliance
LuminaPay

[attachment: retention_request_LuminaPay_20280522.pdf (application/pdf, 42KB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
To: Emma Bradshaw <emma.bradshaw@luminapay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs for LuminaPay EU tenant

Emma — thanks for the note and the attachment. We can run the purge and provide a signed finalization certificate. High-level plan below and I attached our Mutual Action Matrix (MAM) to capture scope/timelines.

- Intake: confirm exact identifiers (tenant SID, dataset tags, retention windows) — done via MAM.
- Ops run: SRE will execute a scoped sweep that removes prompt inputs, outputs, and request logs from the KV cache, object store, and request-log index for the specified interval.
- Verification: SRE will run differential checks and a tamper-evident hash report; Security (Neha) will review results.
- Evidence: we deliver an ops-run report + artifacts bundle + a signed finalization certificate for LuminaPay legal.
- Timeline: target completion in 48–72 hours after signed MAM + DocuSign authorization.

Attachments provided: lumina_mam_template.xlsx (please populate and return), ops_runbook_erasure_checklist.txt (ops-only).

I'll loop Marissa on scheduling. Neha, could you confirm the verification stamp we use for EU-region requests?

—Vivek
VP, Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

[attachment: lumina_mam_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 18KB)][attachment: ops_runbook_erasure_checklist.txt (text/plain, 9KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Emma Bradshaw <emma.bradshaw@luminapay.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs for LuminaPay EU tenant

Thanks Vivek — ops is available to run the sweep on 2028-05-24 02:00 UTC (low traffic window). Work items for LuminaPay: populate the MAM with the tenant SID and confirm the exact object prefixes to be removed. Once MAM is signed we will:

1) Create run ticket and snapshot current indices.
2) Run deletion tooling (kv-sweep + objstore-expunger + log-index-pruner).
3) Produce verification manifest (file hash list + query counts).
4) Run a validation job that attempts to reconstruct a small sample of redacted outputs — should return empty.
5) Produce finalization_certificate_luminapay.pdf and package evidence.

I attached a lightweight ops checklist and a draft confirmation email that we can send to the customer once finalization is complete. I also prepared a DocuSign envelope for LuminaPay to authorize.

Marissa Cole
Senior SRE, Runtime Operations
Redwood Inference

[attachment: ops_runbook_erasure_checklist.txt (text/plain, 11KB)][attachment: draft_customer_confirmation_template.txt (text/plain, 2KB)][attachment: docusign-envelope-98765.pdf (application/pdf, 35KB)]

Date: Wed, 23 May 2028 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs for LuminaPay EU tenant

Marissa — thanks. I populated and signed the MAM and completed the DocuSign envelope this morning. The signed MAM is attached. Please proceed with the run on the 24th per the proposed window. Our legal team will need the finalization certificate and the ops manifest (hash list + evidence bundle) for retention.

Emma Bradshaw
Head of Platform Compliance, LuminaPay

[attachment: signed_lumina_mam_20280523.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 26KB)][attachment: docusign-signed-98765.pdf (application/pdf, 12KB)]

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com
Date: Thu, 24 May 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs for LuminaPay EU tenant — Completion and Certificate

Emma — the sweep completed successfully in the scheduled window. Summary and artifacts below.

- Ops run ticket: RUN-ERASE-2028-98765
- Scope executed: tenant SID=lumina-eu-001; date range 2026-01-01 to 2028-05-01; object prefixes: /lumina/eu/instances/* and /lumina/eu/requests/*
- Verification: differential check (pre/post) returned zero records for the sample queries; hash manifest attached.
- Evidence bundle: drive link provided (see below).
- Finalization certificate: attached and signed.

Standard confirmation email (sent below) has been dispatched to LuminaPay legal and platform contacts. Please keep the evidence bundle link for your records. If you require an additional attestation letter on company letterhead, we can provide that under your contract.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
